description:
Declare rule severity and rule scope through the vocabulary macro.

## Background

`Severity::token` and `RuleScope::token` (`crates/jit/src/declarations/rules.rs:180-215`) hand-write the spellings their serde forms already state.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Severity` and `RuleScope` are declared through the macro, and both `token` functions are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: Rule declarations and rule messages spell severity and scope as before.
title: Rule severity and scope tokens come from one declaration
